rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 40, Step 1, question 1: "If, in 2025: 3 or more children who have valid SSNs lived with you, is the amount on Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b, less than $61,555 ($68,675 if married filing jointly)? ... No. STOP You can't take the credit." i1040gi p. 46, Worksheet A: "Use this worksheet only if you answered “No” to Step 5, question 2. Otherwise, use Worksheet B." i1040gi p. 46, Worksheet A, line 2: "If line 2 is zero, STOP You can't take the credit." The candidate looks up line 2 on every return with no outside-the-table case and no Step 1 to 5 test. Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/eic.deepseek.json; 1,099 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 126 partial records; 1,725 comparisons): 698 of 1,725 agree; 819 candidate-unknown (307 on completed returns), 68 candidate-shows-skipped (26 on completed returns), 20 value, 39 candidate-refuses, 74 project-refuses, 7 project-unknown. Witnesses: classm.f2441.2.deepseek (completed; line 1 $85,000.00, Step 1 question 1 STOP) hidden, candidate unknown (table lookup above the table); classm.sd.1 (completed, Step 1 STOP) hidden, candidate $2,798.00. The value differences on returns the project completes or leaves incomplete are all Worksheet B filers (eic.self_employed true): the project's printed line 2 also carries Worksheet B line 7 (cite: "Worksheet A lines 2 to 6 are Worksheet B lines 7 to 11"), which the candidate's Worksheet A line cannot express; interface gap, as in round 2. The value differences on refused returns are Worksheet B values or lines whose shown_when itself refuses or is unknown (classm.sc.1: eic.eligible refuses on person[spouse].f8889[hsa].excess), which triage counts as shown; no amount is filed (scope). Witnesses: classm.f8880.1 project $0.00, candidate $2,798.00; stage14.eic.wsb_loss $614.00 against $649.00. The refusals and project-unknown are on returns the project refuses (scope).

The candidate shows line 4b (a copy of Step 5 earned income) on every return, including filers who never reach Step 5 or answer No to Step 5, question 2, and refuses every self-employed filer; the project shows 4b only on eic.show_wsb4b (BUG-0156: Step 5 reached and Step 5, question 2 Yes). Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/eic.deepseek.json; 1,099 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 126 partial records; 1,725 comparisons): 491 of 1,725 agree; 905 candidate-shows-skipped (418 on completed returns), 297 candidate-refuses (127 on completed returns), 21 candidate-unknown, 11 project-refuses. Witness: classm.f2441.2.deepseek (completed; no Schedule C, Step 1 question 1 STOP) hidden, candidate $85,000.00. The candidate refuses every Worksheet B filer (its eic.wsb_4b refuses on eic.self_employed, note: "The self-employment, farm and statutory-employee parts of Worksheet B are not supplied by the closed interface"), but the published interface carries person.eic_se, Worksheet B Parts 1 and 2 per person, which the Claude reviewer used; the project computes Worksheet B. A refusal of a computation the source defines and the interface supports is a model error, not a scope screen. Witness: classm.f5695.5 (completed). The candidate-unknown are incomplete records (ss.multi, ss.base.below) where the project hides the line without reading the withheld answer. The 11 project-refuses are the cited scope.schedule1 gate (stage12.refuse.tips_trade_or_business), scope. BUG-0156 check: eic.show_wsb4b requires eic.reached_step5, so 4b is hidden for a filer who does not reach Step 5, and no project-side difference on 4b occurs on a completed return. Project stands.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; the candidate encodes a skipped line 5 as zero and the project does not. i1040gi p. 46, Worksheet A, line 4: "Are the amounts on lines 3 and 1 the same? Yes. Skip line 5; enter the amount from line 2 on line 6." and line 5: "... is the amount on line 3 less than $10,620 ($17,730 if married filing jointly)? ... Yes. Leave line 5 blank; enter the amount from line 2 on line 6." executable-triage-v1 (triage/eic.deepseek.json; same bank, 1,717 comparisons): 188 differ - 92 value (project positive, candidate 0.00) and 95 project-unknown, every one on a return where line 4 is Yes or line 5 is to be left blank (derivation: eic.line4 True or eic.line5_blank True on all 187), e.g. classm.f2441.4 (line 4 Yes, project 1,709.00), classm.eic.3 (line 4 Yes, 5,490.00), classm.eic.1 (line 3 2,137.00 below $10,620, 723.00), classm.asset.4 / classm.s1.2 (negative AGI: "no band", no value). Line 6 does not read line 5 there, so the credit is unaffected. Under the README skipped-line rule a nonzero amount (or no value) on a line the source says to skip is a defect of the side producing it, here the project. The 1 candidate-refuses (audit.household.filer_under16) is a cited household screen the project also refuses on the return: scope. See eic.findings.md F1.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 44, Special rule for separated spouses: "If you are married, but not filing a joint return, had a qualifying child who lived with you ... If you meet these requirements, make sure you check the box in the Dependents section that discusses the special rule for separated spouses"; i1040gi p. 41, Step 3, question 3: "Are you a married taxpayer whose filing status is married filing separately or head of household?" The candidate tests filing status only (its note: "actual married status is not separately supplied"), so an unmarried head of household gets the box; household.married is in the published interface and the project reads it (eic.married_rules). Triage executable-triage-v2 (triage/eic.deepseek.json; 1,099 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 126 partial records; 1,725 comparisons): 977 of 1,725 agree; 144 value (35 on completed returns), 182 candidate-unknown, 422 project-refuses. Witness: classm.f5695.1 (completed; head of household, household.married no) project no, candidate yes. The candidate-unknown are eic.same_home and eic.legally_separated, which the interview asks only of a married filer (classm.f2441.1.deepseek, completed): answers the source does not need for that filer, a model error. The project-refuses are cited project gates on refused returns (f2441.line14_bad, sd.other_forms, sales[s1].digital; scope). Project stands.
